choice.title: Core C/C++ SDK & XCFramework
choice.description: Universal liblanvid_core.dylib (arm64 NEON + x86_64 AVX2), LanVidCore.xcframework (iOS + macOS + Simulator), C/C++17 headers, CMake & pkg-config packages, and lanvid-sdk-info CLI.

choice.title: Swift Package LanVidKit
choice.description: Idiomatic Swift 5.9+ async/await wrapper (LanVidSender, LanVidReceiver, LanVidDiscovery, MetalVideoView) for iOS 15+ and macOS 12+.

choice.title: Python Bindings & Xcode/CMake Examples
choice.description: Zero-dependency Python ctypes/NumPy wrapper (lanvid_sdk.py), SwiftUI iOSCameraSender & MacReceiverMetal examples, and CMake C++17 client.

choice.title: Virtual Audio Device «LanVid Virtual 64ch»
choice.description: CoreAudio HAL plug-in (64 In / 64 Out, Float32, 48/96 kHz) installed to /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/HAL. Appears in Audio MIDI Setup, Logic Pro, REAPER and OBS; streams through LanVid Studio. Restarts coreaudiod.
